notes.title: New Game Mode and Custom Game Settings
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We have added a new Game Mode called "Last Ship Standing" in which each player has 10 lives by default and the last player alive wins.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28729278/f17725319b024c383bc137b4384d0972fa6e5f48.png[/img]

Moreover, you can finally tweak the Game Settings to your liking.
Set the round time, arena switch time, number of lives, movement speed and enable or disable certain events and items.
Game Settings are available in local multiplayer and in private online matches.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28729278/251caebd6c4a7d571f38e9a550d662a57e79aebb.gif[/img]

Try out a game with super fast movement speed!

notes.title: Trail of Destruction Launched Today!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Thanks for all of your support during greenlight!
We were very happy about your feedback, which was mostly positive.
We hope you enjoy our game as much as we do!

Website: https://trailofdestructionsite.wordpress.com/
